SELECT upm.sku sku , sku.sku_name skuName , upm.cust_code custCode , cst.cust_name custName , upm.unit_price_type unitPriceType , cod.code_name unitPriceTypeName , upm.start_date startDate , upm.unit_price unitPrice FROM tb_unit_price_master upm JOIN tb_sku_master sku ON (upm.company_code = sku.company_code AND upm.sku = sku.sku) JOIN tb_cust_master cst ON (upm.company_code = cst.company_code AND upm.cust_code = cst.cust_code) JOIN tb_cm_code cod ON (upm.unit_price_type = cod.code AND cod.group_code = 'UNIT_PRICE_TYPE') WHERE 1=1
AND upm.sku like '%' || #{sku} || '%'
AND sku.sku_name like '%'|| #{skuName} ||'%'
AND upm.unit_price_type = #{unitPriceType}
AND upm.cust_code like '%'|| #{custCode} || '%'
AND cst.cust_name like '%'|| #{custName} ||'%'
ORDER BY sku
